value.rationale: This is a complete sharp one-parameter covariance-admissibility classification on the natural incidence metric of every equal-order finite generalized hexagon, across an unbounded family and without transitivity assumptions. It yields an explicit rank-one boundary degeneration and proves failure of graph-metric negative type. The exact log(q) boundary is not merely a routine small numerical refinement: without the factorization the sign across seven spectral sectors is not apparent, and the fact directly governs valid distance-based covariance design.
